jade:
Create a breathtaking FINISHED panoramic PAINTING, full-bleed 16:9 landscape, titled in concept “A Thousand Jade Peaks / 千峰流碧”. This is a dedicated immersive background for a literary creative workspace named Glaze Realm. Absolutely NO text, signatures, seals, UI, books, borders, paper margins, people, logos or mockup frames.

Make the ENTIRE canvas a richly composed world one can step into, with painted scenery and color extending into ALL FOUR CORNERS. No blank half of the picture, no fade-to-white, no reserved text zone. Broad coherent masses and atmospheric depth, rather than equal detail everywhere. A sophisticated contemporary interpretation of Chinese blue-green mineral-pigment landscape painting with luminous celadon/jade glazing and occasional very fine warm gold mineral seams. Visibly HAND-PAINTED pigment on silk: layered azurite and malachite brushwork, granular washes, purposeful dry brush on the crags, velvety painterly surfaces, subtle silk texture. Painterly, NOT a photorealistic landscape, NOT computer-generated crystal triangles, NOT a 3D glass render.

Scene: a grand emerald river valley seen from a high riverside terrace. A monumental close cliff with elegant pines leans in from the LEFT edge; the foreground lower-left contains mossy stone ledges and graceful grass brushwork. Across the center, a luminous jade river winds diagonally between successive layered blue-green mountain ranges. The river has elegant long brushstroke reflections. On the RIGHT, a soaring rugged mineral-green mountain rises in three overlapping planes, sparse calligraphic tree silhouettes, a few tiny warm ivory roof-lines half-hidden in the landscape to suggest worlds and stories. Distant mountains fill the upper middle, with pale turquoise cloud bands slipping horizontally BETWEEN mountain planes, never erasing the painting. Top-left is canopy and mountain color, top-right is cliffs and teal-blue atmospheric sky, lower-right is reflected jade water and vegetation. Add a slender painted stone footbridge near center-right at small scale, grounded and plausible.

COLORS: rich malachite green, oxidized jade, deep blue teal, muted lapis in distant mountains, pale mist green, tiny restrained antique gold glints. A small warm ivory sun glow high near x65%, y19%, diffused through painted atmosphere, NOT a giant orb. Deep green foreground at left and bottom naturally anchors the light river center. Beautiful elegant value hierarchy: dark foreground frames, luminous jade valley, layered distant depth, deliberate large brushstrokes. Museum-quality contemporary mineral-pigment painting and sophisticated fantasy book illustration, highly authored composition. Lyrical, serene, literary, transportive, exquisite painterly detail. Restrained glow, no neon, no glitter, no particle effects, no plastic ribbons or stock gradient blobs. The image itself is the complete world, not a small illustration sitting on a plain background.
garden:
Create an exquisite FINISHED panoramic oil painting, 16:9 widescreen, “Garden of Painted Light / 花汀浮光”, a full-bleed immersive ART background for a premium novel-writing studio called Glaze Realm. No text, letters, UI, books, signatures, logos, borders or decorative frames. ALL FOUR CORNERS and the entire canvas must contain painting and color. No blank side, no large empty fog or fade to white, no reserved typography zone.

Direction: lyrical contemporary IMPRESSIONIST painting of a secret water garden at blue hour, with a luminous pearlescent violet / rose / jade palette. Visibly tactile, masterfully placed broken brushstrokes, soft layered oil glazes, selective delicate impasto, complex color mixing and fine canvas weave; unmistakably a painting rather than a photograph or 3D render. Emotionally inviting, sophisticated color harmony, a real sense of entering the canvas. Avoid a cluttered storybook garden or overly sugary fantasy illustration.

Composition: viewer stands very low beside a lily pond that occupies the entire LOWER TWO THIRDS, with long horizontal brushstroke reflections flowing all the way to bottom corners. Foreground lily pads and a few exquisite pale rose and ivory water lilies at the lower LEFT, smaller scattered lilies cross toward right. An asymmetrical curtain of softly painted willow branches enters the upper LEFT. At the upper RIGHT, cascades of lavender wisteria bloom over a weathered stone garden arch, the arch is partly cropped and hidden by foliage, not a central portal or frame. A slim curved garden bridge sits far back near x58%,y36%, giving depth at a small scale. The middle distance has a calm jewel teal water opening and a low garden bank with dark dusty-lilac foliage. Peach sunset glazes and pale lavender are reflected in water, with a few warm rose-gold streaks but no separate glowing particles. Blue-green, sage, dusty plum and periwinkle interweave across the water; rich yet gentle. Background treetops and pale apricot-violet dusk sky fill the upper middle with soft irregular brush marks, NOT blank white mist. Strong foreground / middle / distant planes. Harmonize larger quiet pools of color with concentrated brush detail at left lilies and right wisteria.

Painted light is the protagonist: a few nuanced warm brushstrokes seem to float on cool water, luminous translucent oil glazes, a dreamlike atmosphere created by hue and reflected light instead of glitter, neon or artificial glow. Broad intentional strokes, beautiful color edges, slight abstraction in reflections. The palette is mostly deep blue-green and muted lavender, balanced by ivory, celadon and very restrained rose / peach gold; not candy pink, not oversaturated purple. Elegant, lush, intimate, literary, sensuous. Every part of the image is an inhabited painted world, with scene content reaching the edges. This is a world apart from Chinese mountain landscapes; no mountains, crystal cliffs, Asian temples, glass ribbons, spheres or symmetrical composition.
